name: Hutton Hotel
insider_take: Nashville's coolest boutique hotel where Music City's creative energy meets sophisticated luxury in the heart of Music Row.
whats_special: The Hutton Hotel is the only LEED Gold-certified hotel in Nashville, featuring stunning contemporary art throughout and floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing the city skyline. Located on legendary Music Row, you're steps away from historic recording studios where Elvis, Dolly Parton, and countless country legends made music history.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 15+ for panoramic views of downtown Nashville and catch the sunset over the Cumberland River from your room.
dont_miss: The rooftop bar 1808 offers breathtaking 360-degree views of Nashville's skyline, while the hotel's curated art collection features works by local Nashville artists. Take a short walk to the famous RCA Studio B, known as "The Home of 1,000 Hits," where you can tour the studio where Elvis recorded over 200 songs.
pros: Prime location in Music Row district near Nashville's entertainment venues
Boutique luxury experience with sophisticated contemporary design
Award-winning on-site dining at 1808 Grille restaurant
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional Southern charm some expect
